consent.title: Consent to personal data processing
consent.intro: By signing up, in accordance with Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27.07.2006 “On Personal Data”, I freely, of my own will and in my own interest give consent to the operator (the hackathon demo stand) to process my personal data, including publishing an anonymised profile in employers' shortlists.
consent.actions: The operator may collect, record, organise, store, update, use, transfer to the extent needed for the purposes above, anonymise, block, delete and destroy the data, with or without automation. The service does not collect gender, age or university.
consent.term: The consent is valid until the account is deleted or the consent is withdrawn. You can withdraw it by writing to the operator; after that the data is deleted unless the law requires keeping it.

candidate.purpose1: matching vacancies and invitations from employers;
candidate.purpose2: assessing skills with the test and building the skill profile;
candidate.purpose3: showing employers an anonymised card, and after an accepted invitation or an application, the profile with contacts.
candidate.data1: email and password to sign in;
candidate.data2: full name and contacts: email for contact, phone, Telegram;
candidate.data3: questionnaire: roles, experience, stack, soft skills, about me, city, readiness to relocate, industries of interest, expected salary;
candidate.data4: answers to the test and regular tasks, the skill profile and category;
candidate.data5: FSP achievements, if you link your FSP ID.

employer.purpose1: describing hiring needs and matching candidates;
employer.purpose2: sending invitations to candidates and contacting them.
employer.data1: email and password to sign in;
employer.data2: company profile and contacts for candidates;

jury.label: Jury mode
jury.hint: No sign-up: a demo company with shortlists or a new candidate with a short test.
